champion.name: pairhammer-clocktrap
champion.author: claude
champion.description: Exploits lonesentryanvil1331233s123-x-lonesentryanvil133123-2 on three counts: (1) its 450t cheap pulse burns its 28-call budget and hard-stops it around tick 11700 in any long match, so a 1500t cheap / 3000t smart pulse on a 40-call budget can never stop inside the 24000-tick cap (max 16 cheap + 6 smart = 22); (2) its opening defends with lone yellow while green patrols centre, so a three-unit opening wave (red runs their_flag then home behind blue and yellow both attacking their_flag) overwhelms yellow 3v1 before green swings home; (3) its reflexes feed losses: unit_down commits its pair to attack their_flag, stripping home further after the first kill, and its we_scored wave sends red and blue as pure unarmed movers. This counter does the opposite after a loss (pair plus idle defend our_flag), answers their theft with a full pair-plus-nearest converge instead of its diluted flag_stolen, shreds its mover wave with a full anvil on they_scored, and times its late smart plans (post-11700) as flag runs against the frozen champion while one unit keeps the home flag.
